rules.title: Splice bolt grip definitions
rules.statement: Flange splice grip = tf + outer plate t + inner plate t; web splice grip = tw + 2 × web plate t.

rules.title: Anchor bolt length & naming
rules.statement: Anchor bolt length = ROUND((S11+S12+3d+H)/10)*10 (newer rows round to 50 mm: ROUND(x/50)*50); named "AB M{d}(L-{len})" or J-type "AB M{d}(J-{len})". Used when S11 > 99, else a TS bolt is emitted.

verification.detail: Cached JOINT-BASE!AG2 = 740, AG7 = 650 reproduce from the row inputs (same workbook; non-independent).
No second bolt-weight source in the asset set.

rules.title: SCSS bolt weight per splice
rules.statement: Splice bolt weight [kg] = ROUND(set_g(d, L) × 0.001 × qty, 2), looking up the bolt table column L/5.

rules.title: Engine hole-diameter rules disagree from M24
rules.statement: Bolts.HoleFor returns d+2 up to M22 and d+3 from M24 (KDS 14 31 25 standard hole), but BoltPattern.HoleDia always returns d+2 — M24 splice holes come out 26 instead of 27.

verification.detail: Two engine call paths give different holes for d ≥ 24.

rules.engine_note: Fix: BoltPattern.HoleDia should delegate to Bolts.HoleFor.

rules.title: Hole/bolt symbol blocks D{d}x{L}
rules.statement: Blocks D12x22 … D28x78 are side-view symbols whose half-height is d/2; most are drawn L/2 long from the base point. The name encodes diameter × length.
rules.rationale: Geometry confirms d; whether d is the bolt or the hole diameter (D26 → M24 hole 26 would contradict KDS 27) cannot be decided without the HOLE-DIA-TABLE text, which is not extractable from the DWG here.

verification.detail: half-height = d/2 on 11/11 blocks; half-length = L/2 on 8/11 (D18x40, D18x48, D26x56 differ).

rules.title: Splice table key = {C|G}{bolt d}{spec}
rules.statement: Splice standards are keyed by member role (C column / G girder), bolt diameter and section spec; program files are SCSS-{C|G}{16|20|22}.dat.

verification.detail: Key shape in 단중.xlsx matches the 6 .dat file names (role × {16,20,22}).

rules.title: Web splice plate length
rules.statement: Web splice plate length = 2·e_end + 2·e_gap + 2·n·p + 5 (splice gap).

rules.title: Web splice plate height
rules.statement: Web splice plate height = e_top + m·g + e_bot (bolt rows m intervals at pitch g).

verification.detail: Residual AL = 0 on 350/350 rows.

rules.title: Web splice bolt count
rules.statement: Web splice bolts = 2·(n+1)·(m+1) (both sides of the joint).

verification.detail: Residual AM = 0 on 292/350 rows; remaining rows have hand-edited bolt counts.

rules.title: Splice plate thickness per section (xlsx vs .dat)

rules.title: Splice plate weight
rules.statement: Plate weight [kg] = ROUNDDOWN(qty·t·w·l·7.85e-6, 2).

verification.detail: Recomputed 350/350 cached plate weights; density cross-checked by WT-001.

rules.engine_note: Engine rounds to 2 dp (Math.Round, not floor).

rules.title: Steel density 7.85 (0.00785 kg/mm²/m)
rules.statement: All weight formulas use ρ = 7.85 t/m³: kg/m = area[mm²]·0.00785; kg = volume[mm³]·7.85e-6.

verification.detail: BH-BEAM.dat 159/159, H-BEAM.dat 81/81, FLAT-BAR.dat 40/41 (F915x3.2 is a mislabelled row).

rules.title: H/BH unit weight formula
rules.statement: H/BH kg/m = ROUND((2·B·tf + (H−2·tf)·tw + (4−π)·r²)·0.00785, 1), r = root radius (BH: r = tw).

verification.detail: BH-BEAM.dat 159/159, H-BEAM.dat 81/81 within max(0.1, 0.5%).

rules.engine_note: Table lookup is used first; the parsed-spec fallback ignores the root fillet (4−π)r² and rounds to 2 dp.

rules.title: H/BH paint area per metre
rules.statement: H/BH paint area [m²/m] = ROUND((2H + 4B − 2tw)/1000, 3).

verification.detail: BH-BEAM.dat 159/159, H-BEAM.dat 81/81 within 0.011.

rules.title: Plate weight = t × area × 7.85
rules.statement: Plate unit weight = t[mm]·7.85 kg/m²; plate weight = t·w·l·7.85e-6 kg.

verification.detail: Workbook VBA, SCSS formula and engine agree; FLAT-BAR table 40/41.

rules.title: BOM weight = length[m] × unit kg/m
rules.statement: BOM line length [m] = qty·L[mm]·0.001; weight [kg] = length[m] × unit weight.

verification.detail: 자재산출서 literal O = M×N on 8/8 rows.

rules.title: BOM paint area = length[m] × paint m²/m
rules.statement: Paint area per BOM line = length[m] × PAINT[m²/m] from the section table, bucketed by finish (내화페인트/내화피복/광명단 …).

verification.detail: Q = M × HLCCT paint on 8/8 rows.

rules.title: BOM part name = {drawing}-{MARK}-{seq}
rules.statement: BOM piece names are '{drawing no}-{member mark}-{running number}', the running number continuing within a drawing.

rules.title: Shear stud quantity
rules.statement: Studs per metre = (1000/pitch)·ROUNDUP(B/225); stud rows across the flange = ROUNDUP(B/225); row spacing = ROUNDDOWN(B/2).

rules.title: Cover-sheet tonnage factor 0.0005
rules.statement: 견적표지 tonnage = SUM(자재집계표!F:F)·0.0005: the whole-column SUM double-counts the subtotal row, so ×0.0005 equals kg/1000.
rules.rationale: 0.0005 is only correct while F:F holds rows + one subtotal; adding a second subtotal would silently overstate tonnage.

rules.title: Material markup (할증): shapes 9 %, plates 12 %, bolts 3 %
rules.statement: Ordered quantity = ROUNDUP(net × (1 + m), 0) with m = 0.09 for rolled/built shapes and deck, 0.12 for steel plate, 0.03 for bolts/anchors/studs/turnbuckles.

evidence.locator: VBA 자재집계표.bas 매크로5: Case "STEEL-PLATE" → ROUNDUP(RC[-4]*1.12,0); HTB/TS/AB/STUD → *1.03; shapes → *1.09

verification.detail: 2017 VBA and the BOM template's 사용자 sheet agree; cached J2:J9 reproduce 8/8.

rules.title: Markup override by ordered lengths
rules.statement: If an ordered length (H) is given, ordered weight = count × length[m] × unit weight instead of the % markup.

rules.title: Cutting kerf 3 mm per cut
rules.statement: Each saw/torch cut consumes 3 mm (절단두께) in the shape cutting plan.

rules.title: Stock lengths for cutting plan
rules.statement: Preferred stock 10000 then 12000 mm (3rd preference off), orderable 6000–15000 mm in 1000 mm steps; 21 mm over-length usable.

rules.title: Stock length formula
rules.statement: New stock length = MAX(INT((used + cuts·kerf + step − overuse)/step)·step, min).

rules.title: Cutting-plan loss thresholds
rules.statement: Allowed residual before trying another combination: 150 mm on 1st-preference stock, 100 mm on 2nd, 50 mm otherwise (허용로스 50 ×3/×2/×1); max scrap 999 mm; initial squaring loss 0.

rules.title: Section spec key = 구분 + A*B*C*D
rules.statement: Section keys are built as kind letters followed by '*'-joined dimensions (e.g. BH300*300*15*20).

rules.statement: Assembly auto-numbering ignores members shorter than 1999 mm and filters layers '5,6,기존'.
rules.rationale: Meaning taken from key names (ASY-MIN-LENGTH, LAYER-FILTER); no dialog/manual text ingested.
